items.title: LeBron James and the 10 best 'last acts' of an NBA career
items.summary: If we're talking "last acts" of an NBA career, it is hard to top Bill Russell, who led the Boston Celtics as player-coach to Game 7 of the 1969 NBA Finals, defeating the rival Los Angeles Lakers for an 11th championship in 13 seasons. And he retired at age 34.LeBron James will presumably pen the final chapter of the most narrative-driven career in sports history, as the 41-year-old will sign with the … Philadelphia 76ers.Yeah, he's jumping teams — again. To another high-powered outfit, which now boasts James, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Jaylen Brown and Joel Embiid. We can debate what that will mean for his legacy until the end of time (if his career ever ends by then), but there is no doubt that it will be one of the great last acts of an NBA career.He is, after all, still an All-Star, still capable of contributing to a championship team, and anything remotely close to either of those…

items.title: Thunder reportedly sign restricted free agent Spencer Jones to 2-year, $12 million offer sheet; Nuggets have 48 hours to match
items.summary: Restricted free-agent forward Spencer Jones has agreed to a two-year, $12 million offer sheet with the Oklahoma City Thunder, ESPN's Shams Charania reported Saturday. Jones' current team, the Denver Nuggets, has until 11:59 p.m. ET Sunday to decide whether to match the offer, which is fully guaranteed. Jones, 25, just finished his second season with Denver, averaging 5.5 points and 3.3 rebounds in 22 minutes per game. He appeared in 64 games, starting 37 for the 54-28 Nuggets, who finished third in the Western Conference. More importantly, Jones shot 40% on 144 3-point attempts. (In the playoffs, he shot 69% on 13 3-point shots.)For a Thunder team that traded three of its top five 3-point shooters during this offseason, Jones' long-range accuracy could be especially valuable. Isaiah Joe (42%) was dealt to the Detroit Pistons, while Lu Dort (372 attempts) and Aaron Wiggins (270 attempts)…
